user.title: Ubuntu server details
user.description: Give this server a name and enter its SSH connection details. A unique Ed25519 key pair will be generated.

install.title: Install Ubuntu monitoring
install.description: **[Open the installer with Copy button]({copy_url})**\n\nHome Assistant serves a temporary server-specific installation script including the generated public SSH key. Copy the command below, run it on Ubuntu, and select **Submit** to connect. The link expires in 30 minutes. Prefer HTTPS for safe installation.

data_description.install_command: Copy the full command, or open the link above to use the Copy button.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid server name, host and monitoring account
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect via SSH. Run the installation command and check host, port, SSH and firewall settings.

abort.already_configured: This Ubuntu host is already configured

init.title: Docker Compose project
init.description: Optionally select a Docker Compose file on this Ubuntu server. The path is registered locally by an Ubuntu administrator. Leave both fields blank to disable Compose monitoring.

register.title: Authorize Docker Compose access
register.description: Run this command on the Ubuntu server as an administrator. It registers only this project and Compose file. Then click Submit. The Home Assistant SSH user is not added to the Docker group.

data_description.registration_command: Copy and run this command on the monitored Ubuntu server using an administrator account.

error.invalid_project: Enter a valid project identifier (letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores).
error.invalid_path: Enter an absolute Linux file path.
